title: Chapter 352: Re-Cultivation
content:
Chapter 352: Re-Cultivation

After practicing for a while, Wang Shuo found that without systematic guidance, he was as good as a waste.

Every change of moves, if the action is not done well, it does not count at all.

In the past, the system guided and the skills were released directly, but now you have to take the initiative to make some actions to achieve this effect.

This made Wang Shuo miserable.

In desperation, Wang Shuo could only take out the book "Basic Gun Technique" and conduct the most basic basic actions such as point, stab, pick, and chop.

In this way, Wang Shuo stayed here for ten days.

During these ten days, many major events happened in Yingying Town.

The general master Leon summoned a channel, challenged the guard and failed, and died on the spot.

Baichuan Zhonggu, the second place on the master list, remained undefeated in 90 games in the arena ranking, tying the first place Zuo Da.

The top general Jiang Song killed a rare (dark gold level) boss in the wild and refined a promotion pill for his younger brother Jiang Mu, and Jiang Mu broke through to the top general in one fell swoop.

Every day, some major events may happen in Yingying Town.

That day, Wang Shuo let out a long roar.

He had practiced the "Dragon Spear Art" to the third level.

As long as the posture was correct, the speed of re-cultivation was still very fast.

After all, he already had the instinct to fight, but he needed to control the force and movements himself. As long as he practiced a lot, he could easily master these skills.

The biggest advantage of de-dataization is that the moves have no CD. As long as the internal force and physical strength are sufficient and the physical strength allows, he can continue to use the two moves of "Dragon Transformation" and "Dragon Out of the Sea".

Wang Shuo's current state is already in a semi-de-dataized state.

As for the last two levels of "Dragon Spear Art", Wang Shuo estimated that it would take several months to practice.

He didn't want to spend time here. Within three months, he still had to find a way to return to Wana Town.

He didn't want to give up this territory.

When he came to the street, Wang Shuo wanted to find a restaurant and have a good meal.

He had noticed before that the people here all used a kind of coin called Shura Coin.

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo walked directly into the Treasure Pavilion.

This is a shop in Yingying Town, which is the most powerful one in the whole town.

"Customer, what do you need?"

"I want to sell a demon pill."

Wang Shuo took out the demon pill that killed the red-haired baboon before.

In this place, this kind of demon pill is just an ordinary commodity.

The transaction was quickly concluded.

This demon pill was sold for 3,000 Shura coins.

Wang Shuo also took a look at the items sold in the shop.

A golden spear weapon is worth 10,000 Shura coins, and a sophisticated weapon is also worth 2,000 Shura coins.

This gave Wang Shuo a basic understanding of the market here.

"Can you introduce the pills here?"

"Ordinary healing pills, such as the Blood Spirit Pill, are worth 500 Shura coins."

"The Qi-restoring pill that restores the internal force value is 600 Shura coins."

"The True Spirit Pill that increases the internal force value is 10,000 Shura coins."

Wang Shuo was not calm when he heard this. There was actually a pill that directly increased the internal force value.

This is equivalent to the experience pill.

It seems that more money is needed.

"Do you have any elixirs that can help break through the level of military commanders?"

"Guest, this kind of promotion elixir requires you to provide an inner elixir of a dark gold boss. We can help you refine it. The cost is 100,000 Shura coins. If the refining fails, we will compensate you."

Wang Shuo took a deep breath.

This is really not cheap.

Wang Shuo now knows how to break through the level limit.

That is to practice the main internal skills to a certain degree, the internal force value will reach a certain limit, and then break through, and you can be promoted.

At present, his "Black Dragon Sutra" has been practiced to the third level, and he only needs to practice to the fourth level to break through to the top military commander.

Before practicing, he didn't know that the so-called bottleneck was mainly because he used the military commander's job transfer certificate.

Taking the promotion pill is equivalent to breaking the bottleneck, which is similar to the military commander's job transfer certificate.
